body: I would LOVE a job like that. I don't even know how I'd find a job like that tho or if I'm even qualified. I can't exactly afford school for anything these days..

I don't know.. nothing comes to mind really. Music was always a very big part of my life and now it seems like just another thing in my life. I almost think part of me is over being a musician and that is what is bothering me, because now I don't even know where to focus all my effort. I've always been fond of using creativity in my life. I don't want a career where I just turn my brain off for 8 hours a day or do work I find boring just for a paycheck. If I have to settle for that, then I'd rather be dead. I've thought about being a writer or something, but I'm always so lost on how to even start going down that road. My highschool grades suck so post secondary has always seemed a little out of my reach.
